mystic_world_p2.caption: at the edge of a glowing lake in a mystical alien valley at twilight; floating rock mountains with waterfalls hover above the valley and mirror in the lake, the shores are covered with giant bioluminescent plants with translucent petals, glowing reeds and tall coral-like trees, flocks of small glowing winged creatures far away, a deep teal sky with two moons

lantern_festival_p1.caption: viewed from a wooden boat on a calm lake at night during a lantern festival, other boats with people floating nearby, a moderate number of glowing paper lanterns rising into the starry sky and floating on the water, a traditional pavilion lit on the shore, warm reflections on the water

lantern_festival_p2.caption: in a traditional asian night market street; rows of red paper lanterns hang overhead, wooden shopfronts with painted signs, small food stalls with rising steam, warm orange light on the wet stone street, a narrow sky above

city_night_view_p1.caption: on a glass observation deck at the top of a tall skyscraper at night; a glittering city skyline in every direction, lit towers with blinking red lights, streets with flowing white and red car lights, a river with illuminated bridges, a deep blue sky with a few clouds

city_night_view_p2.caption: in a riverside park at night with a view of a wide river; illuminated arched bridges cross the water, a glowing city skyline on the far bank reflects in the river, grass and a walking path along the shore, street lamps, a deep blue night sky
